methods.last35: Last35 saved per-visible-second samples; 34 seconds between first and last timestamps. Both cutoff runs cover HUD elapsed116–150. Wins end earlier.
methods.targetType: mapOnly=true => scout; otherwise npc=true => bodyNpc; remaining target => food; null => none. cap200-finish reason is not treated as target category.
methods.capPhase: All saved samples with HUD>=186; this is a planner condition, not a guarantee of fast completion.
methods.gain: Predicted radius gain on the chosen2.2-second path; not realized growth and not summed as an accumulated yield.
methods.counts: Recognized per-frame object counts, not ground-truth world density or unique-NPC counts.
methods.nearBodyCheck: Observed selected-target distance<=1.2*HUD is only a screen-distance proxy. No pre-filter components, persistent IDs, original centres or full object arrays are saved, so removal cannot be determined.
methods.visibleSettlement: Successful runs sometimes stop recordingHUD before the final size-changing swallow; success is taken from visible settlement, not last sampled HUD.
